without asking. Confirming is optional: a gap analysis also runs on an unconfirmed CV.

post.description: End the session. Started sessions are billed and scored (FB-3); safe to call twice.
Start the text session: the interviewer greets the candidate.

The candidate's turn. Returns the interviewer's reply; the session ends on its own.

504 when the reply takes longer than TEXT_TURN_TIMEOUT_S, 503 when the turn could not be
saved. In both cases the turn is taken back, and the candidate can send it again.
Coach mode only (IV-8): pause and resume the clock, ask for a hint, redo the answer.

Start the voice session (first join) and return a LiveKit token for its room.

Call it again after a dropped connection: the room stays the same, so the voice agent goes
on at the same phase and question when the candidate is back within 2 minutes (IV-9).

All gap reports and interview debriefs of the signed-in user, newest first (R1).

before the CV was recorded have no CV, so this filter leaves them out.

Spend today and this month for the app key (claude profile).

Dev and test, and in staging for the MODEL_SPEND_VIEWERS emails. Others get 404.
Public: the active site banner and whether sign-ups and new sessions are open.

post.description:
AC-4: create an account with a password and sign in. The email is confirmed later,
from the link we send.
AC-5: email a reset link. Same reply whether or not the email has an account.
AC-5: set a new password from a reset link, and sign in.
Local only (APP_ENV=local). Signs in any email with no check.
Start Stripe Checkout for the plan. The webhook turns the plan on after payment.
Open the Stripe Customer Portal to change the card, see invoices or cancel.
The cancellation exit survey: why the user leaves, and did they get the job.
Stripe calls this. The Stripe-Signature header must match STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

Local only (APP_ENV=local). Uses plan minutes as if a session had ended, so the
subscribe, use, cancel flow can be checked before voice sessions exist.
